_readme: In-world Phaser strings: interaction prompts, world labels (src/game/*.ts). Keys are referenced as game.<key>.

toast.wetlandUnlocked: Rushwater Wetland is unlocked! Follow the boardwalk east to step into the marsh.
toast.wetlandWashedOut: The wetland path is washed out. {label}
toast.desertUnlocked: Redstone Scrubland is unlocked! The desert trail east opens soon.
toast.alpineUnlocked: Graywind Heights is unlocked! The mountain trail opens soon.
toast.coastalUnlocked: Pelican Shore is unlocked! Follow the trail down to the coast.
toast.coastalSnowedIn: The pass down to the coast is snowed in. {label}
toast.oceanView: The open Pacific stretches east as far as you can see. Sea glass, kelp, coral, and the rare pearl wash up along the tideline.
toast.stillRegrowing: Still regrowing — let it rest a little longer.
toast.quietBreath: You take a quiet breath. The preserve is in good hands.

confirm.clearWateredBed: Clear this watered soil bed? The water used on it is lost.

block.standingHere: You're standing here — step off before flooding this bed into open water.
block.gateTrail: The trail gate has to stay walkable — flooding here would seal the way out.

prompt.moveTile: {verb} a tile to move it there
